regional_travel_notes: NH16 and NH116B route offers frequent highway amenities around Kolaghat.
Bargabhima temple in Tamluk has narrow access roads; park near main approach.
Monsoon heavy showers can cause slow moving traffic near Kolaghat bridge.

candidate_places.name: Kolaghat Express Highway Dhaba
candidate_places.description: Popular roadside food plaza known for fresh Bengali breakfasts and hot tea.

candidate_places.name: Deulti Rural Heritage Center
candidate_places.description: Historic residence and peaceful countryside garden along the Rupnarayan river.

candidate_places.name: Tamluk Bargabhima Temple
candidate_places.description: Ancient 1000 year old terracotta style temple dedicated to Goddess Kali.

candidate_places.name: Mahishadal Rajbari Palace
candidate_places.description: Historic estate complex with museum artifacts and traditional temple grounds.

candidate_places.name: Digha Sea Beach Promenade
candidate_places.description: Wide flat coastline on the Bay of Bengal with sea wall walk and cashew groves.
